title: Build a tiny EventBus
prompt: Implement an in-memory publish/subscribe EventBus across events.py and bus.py. events.py defines an Event dataclass with `name` (str) and `payload` (dict). bus.py defines EventBus with subscribe(name, handler), unsubscribe(name, handler), and publish(event) which calls every handler subscribed to event.name with the event, in subscription order. Unknown event names are a no-op.
